basic_details.job_title: DLSA Chennai Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Chennai District Legal Services Authority (சென்னை மாவட்ட சட்டப்பணிகள் ஆணைக்குழு) is inviting applications for Para Legal Volunteers (தன்னார்வ சட்டப்பணியாளர்) for the Chennai DLSA and for the Egmore, Saidapet and George Town Taluk Legal Services Committees. Only eligible people who live in Chennai revenue district may apply. Applications go to the Chairman/Principal District Judge, District Legal Services Authority, ADR Building, Chennai-600 104, either by hand or by registered post. They must reach that office by 5.00 PM on 16 November 2026.

important_dates.interview_date: To be notified on the Chennai District Court website

content_sections.heading: About Chennai DLSA
content_sections.text: The Chennai District Legal Services Authority will select the Para Legal Volunteers for itself and for the Egmore, Saidapet and George Town Taluk Legal Services Committees. The selection follows the orders of the National Legal Services Authority and the Tamil Nadu State Legal Services Authority, and the guidelines of the Chairman/Principal District Judge, District Legal Services Authority. The press release was issued with information from the Chennai District Collector, Tmt. S. Malathi Helen, I.A.S.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the Chennai District Court website, https://chennai.dcourts.gov.in/. Submit the completed form by hand or send it by registered post to this address: Chairman/Principal District Judge, District Legal Services Authority, North Fort Road, ADR Building, Chennai-600 104 Download the application form from the Chennai District Court website (https://chennai.dcourts.gov.in/). Deliver the completed application by hand, or send it by registered post, to the address above. Make sure the application reaches the office by 5.00 PM on 16 November 2026. Applications delayed in the post will not be accepted. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: You must live in Chennai revenue district, want to serve the public, and belong to one of these groups: Teachers (including retired teachers) Retired government employees and senior citizens Students and teachers of Master of Social Work (M.S.W.) Anganwadi workers Doctors and health experts Students and law students (law students only until they register as advocates) Non-political non-governmental social service organisations, and leaders of associations Members of women's groups, Maitri Sanghams (friendship clubs) and self-help groups that include the poor Any other person with a service mindset whom the District / Taluk Legal Services Authority considers suitable The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Check the official notification for the detailed eligibility for the post of Para Legal Volunteer. A Para Legal Volunteer only gives service. This is not permanent employment. The engagement is purely temporary, with no basic salary or wages. An honorarium matching the service is paid, up to a maximum of Rs.750/- per day.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice says candidates will be interviewed. The interview date, the venue and other details will be posted on the Chennai District Court website (https://chennai.dcourts.gov.in/). Applicants will not be told by post, SMS or email.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Chennai DLSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Chennai DLSA Recruitment 2026 has 1 vacancy for Para Legal Volunteer. The notice does not print a number.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the Chennai DLSA Para Legal Volunteer application?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the District Legal Services Authority by 5.00 PM on 16 November 2026. Applications delayed in the post will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for Chennai DLSA Para Legal Volunteer 2026?
faq.answer: You can apply if you live in Chennai revenue district and belong to one of nine listed groups. These include teachers, retired government employees, senior citizens, M.S.W. students and teachers, Anganwadi workers, doctors, law students and members of self-help groups.

faq.question: Q4. What is the honorarium for a Chennai DLSA Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: A Para Legal Volunteer receives an honorarium matching the service, up to a maximum of Rs.750/- per day. There is no basic salary or wages.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for Chennai DLSA Para Legal Volunteer 2026?
faq.answer: Download the form from https://chennai.dcourts.gov.in/. Submit it by hand or send it by registered post to the Chairman/Principal District Judge, District Legal Services Authority, North Fort Road, ADR Building, Chennai-600 104, so that it arrives by 5.00 PM on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for Chennai DLSA Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: Candidates will be interviewed. The interview date, the venue and other details will be posted on the Chennai District Court website, not sent by post, SMS or email.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Chennai DLSA Para Legal Volunteer post a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The work is service only and is not permanent employment. It is purely temporary, with only an honorarium of up to Rs.750/- per day.

faq.question: Q8. Can law students apply for Para Legal Volunteer in Chennai?
faq.answer: Yes. Students and law students may apply, but law students are eligible only until they register as advocates.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need to live in Chennai to apply for the Chennai DLSA Volunteer post?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice invites applications only from eligible people who live in Chennai revenue district.
